_note: Every rate here is copied from an official page, never computed and never estimated. Each section carries its own source URL and the date it was checked. Re-check the source before changing a number, and update _checked_at when you do. The last rate that was inlined in code on this machine came out 18x wrong because the model had changed underneath it.

stt._note: Quoted: $0.04 per hour, and "Minimum billed length: 10 seconds. If you submit a request less than this, you will still be billed for 10 seconds." Duration is taken from Groq's own verbose_json response, not measured locally — they bill on what they report.

tts._note: Quoted from the table whose columns are "Model | Free usage limit | Price after free usage limit is reached": "Chirp 3: HD voices (sku:F977-2280-6F1B) | 0 to 1 million characters | US$0.00003 per character (US$30 per 1 million characters)". The first free million a month is applied by free_tier.py, not here: usd_per_character is the price AFTER it. Corrected 2026-09-23 — an earlier note read the free column as a price band. The same page states the billed count includes spaces and newlines, and all SSML tags except <mark>. Whether the allowance is per billing account or per project is not stated for Text-to-Speech.
tts._free_period: Calendar month from 12 AM US and Canadian Pacific Time (UTC-8), per https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/budgets — see free_tier.py.

stt_google._unit: USD per minute of audio, v1 Standard
stt_google._note: Quoted: billing is "measured in increments of one second" and "Each request is rounded up to the nearest increment of 1 seconds". Standard without data logging: "0 minute to 60 minute $0.00 (Free) / 1 minute, per 1 month / account", then $0.024 / 1 minute ($0.016 with data logging, which this broker does not opt into). The 60 free minutes are applied by free_tier.py; usd_per_minute is the price after them.
stt_google._free_period: Calendar month from 12 AM US and Canadian Pacific Time (UTC-8), per https://docs.cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/budgets — see free_tier.py.

stt_qwen._note: Poom read these off the Model Studio console (Singapore) on 2026-09-24: qwen3-asr-flash $0.000035 per second; qwen3-asr-flash-2026-02-10 carries a free quota of 36,000 seconds that expires 2026-12-23, and Stop-on-Exhaust is Not Enabled, so past it the account is charged rather than stopped. Billed on usage.seconds from the answer, rounded up here to a whole second (rounding rule not stated on the pages read). The free quota is ONE-OFF, not monthly: free_tier.py counts it from the first call, until free_until.
